sql: SELECT d.account_id, (SELECT MAX(A11) - MIN(A11) FROM district) AS gap FROM client c JOIN district dt ON c.district_id = dt.district_id JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F') AND dt.A11 = (SELECT MIN(dt2.A11) FROM client c2 JOIN district dt2 ON c2.district_id = dt2.district_id WHERE c2.gender = 'F' AND c2.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F'))
